objective: Remove the observed native Weather 4-5 second loading delay and measure progress toward sub-second data loading.

cause.nativeBehavior: WeatherService waits for weather data and its corresponding AQI scale before publishing the entire weather tuple. Failed scale requests are raced/retried before the remaining products are built.
cause.confirmedBy: macOS unified WeatherService logs aligned with final Pi bridge and transport events
cause.afterFailedScale: Cannot build air quality due to missing scale; returning temporarily unavailable

baselineMacColdLaunch.firstAxObservation: Not loaded; -- at 2.152 seconds after getApp began.
baselineMacColdLaunch.secondAxObservation: Still not loaded at 5.634 seconds after getApp began.
baselineMacColdLaunch.note: Computer-use acquisition and observation overhead is not a frame-accurate app launch measurement.

scaleReference.nativeSchema: Successful JSON AQI scale responses retained in the local macOS Weather HTTP cache.

verificationStatus: Deployed repair; native Mac data readiness and AQI rendering accepted. User reports fast, normal iPhone loading; iOS served AQI values verified against CWA LinkedAPI observations. No precise iPhone launch timing or physical AQI-card observation.

iphone.physicalLoadingAcceptanceSource: User reported that data arrived quickly and Weather behaved normally after the requested iPhone test.
iphone.physicalUiAcceptanceScope: AQI card and detail rendering remain unobserved; loading acceptance is recorded separately.

limits: Data propagation timestamps establish native data readiness, not frame-accurate first visible pixels.
The first repaired launch, including initial scale acquisition and app startup, took 1.086 seconds from dispatch to first propagation; the subsequent process launch took 0.548 seconds.
No universal sub-second guarantee for Apple/network delay, source-cache misses, system scheduling, or unsupported locales.
Native Taiwan scale serves zh-Hant-TW and en-US only; other locales retain the upstream path.
Optional health recommendations are omitted; advanced AQI detail screens and physical iPhone/Watch AQI-card UI are not yet accepted.
The unauthenticated original Apple scale probe returned HTTP401; the implementation uses successful local native scale JSON schema, not an assumed Taiwan Apple scale identifier.
validationNotes: An immediate quit/relaunch raced macOS process teardown and getApp failed once; a subsequent launch succeeded. No app data was cleared.
One addon assertion initially expected URL locale zh-Hant-TW in the response language field; corrected it to observed native JSON zh-TW.
ccsearch found the official MOENV page but its text fetch failed; the page was then read through the in-app browser.
Private packet metadata and unified logs remain in an ignored mode-restricted directory. No DNS or QUIC remedy was necessary for the measured AQI-scale cause.

Follow-up AQI verification changed no runtime source: both fresh iOS final modified responses match their encoded candidates, official LinkedAPI indexes/categories, and decoded pollutant types/units/amounts. A secondary official website fetch through ccsearch returned HTTP403; no independent MOENV website live-value comparison is claimed. Native Mac UI reacquisition failed at computer-use pipe startup; existing Mac AQI-card evidence remains dated and valid for its sample.
